message:
## Vulnerability Digest

New reporting in the last 24 hours identified relevant issues for Ubuntu/Linux, Ubuntu-packaged components including OpenJDK, MongoDB-related components, and WordPress. The Linux kernel item warrants immediate review because CISA has confirmed exploitation. No other credible in-window report was confirmed for the remaining monitored products.

**Scope**

- Sources: `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only; obvious aliases and duplicates were normalized.
- `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined with this scan.
- Window: 2026-09-21 05:10 IST through 2026-09-22 05:10 IST (2026-09-20 23:40 UTC through 2026-09-21 23:40 UTC).

**Finding 1 — Ubuntu/Linux kernel: three actively exploited CVEs**

- Affected product: Ubuntu systems using affected Linux kernels
- Issue: CVE-2025-39964, CVE-2026-53266, CVE-2025-39682
- Severity: Reported range is Medium to Critical; the reporting source did not map each rating individually
- Description: A newly published report says CISA confirmed exploitation of flaws involving the AF_ALG cryptographic socket interface, ebtables SNAT memory handling, and the kernel TLS receive path.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored, and Canonical has issued recent kernel updates that include CVE-2026-53266 among the corrected issues. Exposure depends on the installed kernel build and configuration.
- Sources: [BleepingComputer, 21 September 2026](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-alerts-of-active-exploitation-of-three-linux-kernel-flaws/); [Canonical Ubuntu security notices](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices)

**Finding 2 — Ubuntu and OpenJDK: same-day Canonical security notice batch**

- Affected products: Ubuntu; OpenJDK 8 and 11
- Issue: Multiple Canonical Ubuntu Security Notices published 21 September 2026
- Severity: Not stated in the cited Canonical notices
- Description: Canonical released fixes for several kernel variants and for GLib, Expat, Memcached, Ghostscript, libxml2, rsyslog, strongSwan, ClamAV, and OpenJDK 8/11. Examples include:
  - GLib, USN-8794-1: CVE-2026-15588, CVE-2026-16118, and CVE-2026-58010 through CVE-2026-58016; impacts include denial of service, information disclosure, out-of-bounds access, and arbitrary client-file reads by a malicious D-Bus server.
  - OpenJDK 8/11, USN-8784-1 and USN-8785-1: CVE-2026-61308, CVE-2026-60589, and CVE-2026-70907.
  - Ubuntu kernel notices, including USN-8793-1, USN-8729-3, USN-8761-3, USN-8730-4, USN-8726-3, and USN-8668-2, correct vulnerabilities across standard, Azure, Azure CVM, IBM, and Raspberry Pi kernel packages.
  - Other package notices include USN-8792-1 (Memcached, CVE-2026-90698), USN-8791-1 (Ghostscript, CVE-2026-39919), USN-8787-1 (libxml2, CVE-2026-86140 and CVE-2026-74860), USN-8786-1 (rsyslog, CVE-2026-78002), USN-8789-1 (strongSwan), USN-8788-1 (ClamAV), and USN-8790-1 (Expat).
- Relevance: Ubuntu and OpenJDK are both explicit monitored entries. Exact applicability depends on Ubuntu release and installed package versions.
- Sources: [Canonical USN-8794-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8794-1); [Canonical USN-8793-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8793-1); [Canonical USN-8785-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8785-1); [Canonical notice index](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices)

**Finding 3 — MongoDB ecosystem: new government advisory for Mongoid and the C Driver**

- Affected components: Mongoid and MongoDB C Driver
- Issue: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security advisory AV26-945; related MongoDB records include CVE-2026-93759, CVE-2026-93760, CVE-2026-93761, CVE-2026-88035, and CVE-2026-88036
- Severity: MongoDB lists CVSS scores from 5.7 to 8.8 for those records
- Description: The Cyber Centre published a 21 September advisory stating that multiple versions of Mongoid and the C Driver are affected. MongoDB's own alerts describe JavaScript/NoSQL injection and regular-expression denial-of-service issues in Mongoid, plus GridFS query-operator injection and a SASL username canonicalization heap overflow in the C Driver.
- Relevance: MongoDB is monitored, and both components are officially maintained parts of its ecosystem.
- Freshness note: The government advisory is new in this run's window, but the underlying MongoDB records are dated 18 September (Mongoid) and 10 September (C Driver); this is a new authoritative alert, not a claim that the CVEs were first disclosed today.
- Sources: [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security AV26-945](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/mongodb-security-advisory); [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

**Finding 4 — WordPress Click2Shell reporting**

- Affected product: WordPress Core 7.1.0 and earlier
- Issue: Click2Shell theme-install/preview injection chain; no CVE was identified in the cited sources
- Severity: Not stated by WordPress
- Description: New reporting on 21 September explains how a crafted link opened by a logged-in administrator can force installation and preview of a WordPress.org theme. Code execution requires chaining the core weakness with a separate vulnerable theme.
- Relevance: WordPress is explicitly monitored.
- Freshness note: The news report is in-window; WordPress shipped the fix in version 7.1.1 on 17 September, and the research disclosure followed on 18 September.
- Sources: [BleepingComputer, 21 September 2026](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/wordpress-click2shell-flaw-lets-hackers-execute-php-on-the-server/); [WordPress 7.1.1 security release](https://wordpress.org/news/2026/09/wordpress-7-1-1-maintenance-and-security-release/); [pwn.ai technical disclosure](https://pwn.ai/blog/click2shell)

**MongoDB ecosystem verification**

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries. No other credible in-window MongoDB finding was confirmed.

**Review priority**

Immediate review is recommended for affected Ubuntu/Linux assets because the three kernel CVEs are reported as actively exploited. Also verify Ubuntu package update status, Mongoid/C Driver versions where used, and that WordPress sites run 7.1.1 or a corresponding patched branch.
